description: ⚠️ Writes files: plan_rename_* and apply_edits in one call, without review. Prefer those two to review first.

configSync.description: With config-sync: also update the config/sync files this refactor concerns (roles' permissions, content-manager views). Default: the user's setting, true unless turned off. false when config/sync isn't yours to change here. The warnings say which files.

from.description: A path inside the project (the file you are editing; relative to its root with `project`), in a multi-project workspace.

method.description: The method to rename; omit to rename the entity.

newName.description: The new method name, or the UID's new last segment.

project.description: A project name or root, when no path is at hand.

ref.description: A Strapi ref: a content-type or component UID (api::article.article, shared.seo), a service/controller/policy/middleware ref (plugin::users-permissions.user, global::is-owner) or a route handler (api::article.article.find); `ref#method` for one method.

name: apply_rename
title: Rename a Strapi entity or method (writes files)
